The GTM Lead, DACH sits within Mistplay’s EMEA Growth team and launches and runs Germany’s growth engine across Android and iOS, with Austria and Switzerland in scope once the German flywheel proves out. You will be reporting to the General Manager, EMEA. Germany is the largest Android gaming market in Western Europe, and we are funding a serious run at it. The org is heavily matrixed today, so you start by looking after every spoke of the flywheel — advertiser budgets, player rewards, creative output, the operating rhythm — tracking performance, flagging what drifts, and driving the fix through UA and Product, who execute for now. As Germany’s revenue and margin prove out, direct operational control of these levers transfers to you — so we need someone who has actually run them before, not only someone who can oversee them. The GM EMEA holds P&L accountability for Germany; you are incentivized on the functional metrics that move the flywheel — users, product and advertiser intelligence — with direct access to functional teams to move all three. The playbook you build is designed to transfer as your scope grows into the wider DACH region. What you’ll do at Mistplay Own Germany’s iOS launch readiness on the ground — catalog seeding, store presence, the UA, Product and creative pieces the launch needs.. Set the audience priorities and return thresholds for German UA and hold our existing EMEA UA team to them. Win the Product capacity Germany needs from a centralized team with its own priorities: make the case, press for it, and keep pressing when the answer is no. Diagnose where the funnel breaks downstream of the install and work the fix through Product and the agency, backed by the measurement layer — cohort economics, payback curves, channel-level yield — you build to know where to look. Direct the German creative agenda through our internal team and creative agency — what to test, the local nuance it must carry, the read-out on what performed — including a push into high-ARPU genres such as Strategy and RPG. Track the health of the German advertiser catalog with Commercial day to day — flag gaps early, press for the fix, so returning and new partners land on real player liquidity. Close the gap between what our German players actually spend and what we can measure: push to get webshop and direct-to-consumer payment data into our performance reporting, so the margin we’re already earning stops hiding in a blind spot. Keep daily watch on the German offer and reward mix, including non-gaming inventory — flag what’s underperforming and work with our non-gaming supply team to fix it, so revenue per player keeps moving. Experience setting direction and holding a function accountable for delivery when you don’t manage it — a UA team, a creative agency, a Product roadmap — briefing sharply, reading what comes back, and pressing when it misses. Comfort being measured on a blend of acquisition, product and commercial outcomes rather than a single clean metric — you think in terms of what moves the whole flywheel, not just your own lever. Điều phối triển khai dự án ·       Phối hợp giữa các bộ phận Engineering, Procurement, Construction, QA/QC, HSE và nhà thầu phụ nhằm đảm bảo thông tin được truyền đạt đầy đủ và kịp thời. ·       Theo dõi và cập nhật tình trạng thực hiện các đầu việc hằng ngày theo kế hoạch dự án. ·       Hỗ trợ tổ chức các cuộc họp dự án, lập biên bản họp và theo dõi các hành động sau cuộc họp. 2. Theo dõi tiến độ và nguồn lực ·       Cập nhật tiến độ dự án theo schedule, milestone và kế hoạch ngắn hạn (look-ahead plan). ·       Theo dõi tình trạng vật tư, thiết bị và phối hợp với các bên liên quan để đảm bảo đáp ứng nhu cầu thi công. ·       Nhận diện các nguy cơ ảnh hưởng đến tiến độ và báo cáo kịp thời cho Project Manager. 3. Investigate suspicious domains, analyze online threats, and collect evidence of brand misuse. Prepare and manage abuse complaints, takedown requests, and incident escalations. Coordinate with domain registrars, hosting providers, and web-security services to resolve reported incidents. Research and test tools and approaches to improve brand protection and threat detection processes. Document incidents, track investigation results, and prepare reports and presentations for team meetings. Collaborate with SEO, Marketing, and Legal teams on brand protection initiatives. Practical experience investigating suspicious domains, phishing, fraud, or brand impersonation cases. Understanding of online threat investigation, evidence collection, and incident management processes. Familiarity with investigation tools such as VirusTotal, URLScan, Google Safe Browsing, WHOIS, Ahrefs, or browser Developer Tools. Confident user of Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, with experience organizing and analyzing data. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to work independently. Good communication skills and the ability to clearly document and present findings. Proficiency in Ukrainian or Russian (written and spoken), with English at B1 (Intermediate) level or higher. Nice to Have: Experience preparing DMCA notices, abuse complaints, or takedown requests. Experience working directly with domain registrars, hosting providers, or web-security services. Basic understanding of APIs and data formats such as JSON and XML. Understanding of SEO, search engine results, and online reputation management. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes Bauingenieurstudium (Dipl.-Ing. oder M.Sc./M.Eng.) mit Schwerpunkt konstruktiver Ingenieurbau Erste Erfahrung in Entwurfs-, Genehmigungs- und Ausführungsplanung wünschenswert Grundkenntnisse in moderner Ingenieur-Software und Planungswerkzeugen Qualifizierte Kenntnisse in Statik und Konstruktion Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamgeist Führerschein Klasse B von Vorteil Wir bieten Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag Die Möglichkeit, an vielseitigen und herausfordernden überregionalen Projekten mitzuarbeiten Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und die Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten Strukturiertes Onboarding mit der Unterstützung durch eine:n erfahrene:n Mentor:in Individuell abgestimmte Karriereplanung und regelmäßige Fortbildungsangebote Die Option auf Business-Bike Leasing und einen 31,50€ steuerfreien Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents, die den Teamgeist stärken und Raum für Austausch bieten. Lernen Sie uns kennen! Bei Kempen Krause vereinen wir über 115 Jahre Ingenieurtraditionen mit dem Anspruch, die Entwicklung der Baubranche aktiv mitzugestalten und uns als modernes, technologisch geprägtes Ingenieurunternehmen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Mit über 400 Experten und Expertinnen in 13 Fachbereichen und zwei Kompetenzzentren an sieben Standorten erstellen wir interdisziplinär zukunftsfähige, nachhaltige und innovative Planungen für komplexe Bauvorhaben und begleiten deren termin- und kostengerechte Umsetzung. Im Fachbereich Tragwerksplanung bieten wir innovative Lösungen und langjährige Erfahrung im Hoch- und Tiefbau. Von der Konzeptentwicklung bis zum detaillierten Entwurf setzen wir moderne digitale Tools und ingenieurtechnische Methoden ein, um maßgeschneiderte, nachhaltige Lösungen zu liefern. Unsere Expertise umfasst Beton- und Stahlbetonbau, Mauerwerksbau, Stahlbau, Holzbau und weitere Bereiche. review_candidates.title: Auxiliar de RH - Reclutadora
review_candidates.description: Nuestro cliente: empresa de manufactura ubicada en zona 8 de Mixco. Objetivo Del Puesto Gestionar el proceso de reclutamiento y selección de personal a todo nivel (administrativo y operativo) y el proceso de desarrollo organizacional (capacitaciones y evaluación del desempeño). El puesto incluye las siguientes actividades: Publicar ofertas laborales, filtrar, entrevistar y evaluar candidatos, coordinar entrevistas con jefaturas. Gestiona el proceso de contratación: completar expediente, realizar ofertas de trabajo, contratos de trabajo e inducción a la empresa. Gestionar los procesos de capacitaciones, evaluación del desempeño y coordinar clima laboral. Realizar actividades administrativas: reportes e informes, indicadores de desempeño, celebraciones con empleados. Forma parte activa del comité bipartito de SSO. Requisitos Graduada a nivel diversificado, con estudios universitarios (1-2 años) en administración, recursos humanos o afín. Experiencia en posiciones de reclutadora, auxiliar de RH, asistente administrativa. Manejo de Office, principalmente word (redacción de documentos) y Excel (realiza reportes e informes, fórmulas básicas, tablas dinámicas). Competencias a evaluar: orientación a resultados, organización, solución de problemas, servicio al cliente, comunicación y confidencialidad. De preferencia residir en áreas cercanas a zona 8 de Mixco. Ofrece Jornada laboral de lunes a viernes. Parqueo para moto. Contrato por tiempo indefinido. Todas las prestaciones de ley.

review_candidates.title: Auxiliar de Ingenieria - Telecomunicaciones
review_candidates.description: Ingeniero/a en Telecomunicaciones (Nivel Semi-Senior / 2 años de experiencia) Resumen del puesto Buscamos un Ingeniero en Telecomunicaciones dinámico y resolutivo para unirse a nuestro equipo técnico. El candidato ideal cuenta con 2 años de experiencia en implementación, mantenimiento y soporte de redes y sistemas de comunicación. Será responsable de garantizar la continuidad operativa, optimizar el rendimiento de la infraestructura y participar en proyectos de despliegue tecnológico. Responsabilidades principales Manejo de personal técnico operativo Coordinación de compras de equipos y materiales. Seguimientos de SLA y KPI, Generación de informes. Monitoreo y soporte: Supervisar el estado de la red (NOC / mesa de nivel 2), diagnosticar fallas y resolver incidencias de conectividad de manera oportuna. Configuración e implementación: Instalar, configurar y administrar equipos activos como routers, switches, firewalls y enlaces inalámbricos o de fibra óptica. Mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo: Ejecutar rutinas de revisión técnica en infraestructura física y lógica para minimizar tiempos de inactividad. Documentación técnica: Elaborar y actualizar topologías de red, inventarios de equipos, bitácoras de cambios y reportes de nivel de servicio (SLA). Gestión con proveedores: Coordinar ventanas de mantenimiento y escalar fallas críticas con operadores de telecomunicaciones y fabricantes. Requisitos indispensables Formación académica: Título profesional en Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería Electrónica, Ingeniería de Redes o carreras afines. Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años comprobables en roles de soporte de redes, operaciones de telecomunicaciones, infraestructura TI o despliegue en campo.
